summary: Discussion-first snapshot: multiple vendor security incidents (OpenAI, Microsoft), Anthropic model and MCP user friction, plus growing infra tools for agent cost, durability, and harnessing. | Vendor-only snapshot: Anthropic’s Opus 5 and OpenAI data-retention policy are top product moves; AWS Bedrock adds web-search/access; Cloudflare, Modal, and JetBrains posts signal infra/security/IDE agent deltas. No social/operator reports in this shard — user_workflow coverage missing. | GitHub snapshot: mix of high-traction agent platforms and vendor CLI releases (Gemini, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex), plus sandboxing, eval, and on-device/browser infra. Missing social/operator field reports for real-world workflows. | Packages-sourced snapshot: a mix of vendor CLIs (OpenAI, GitHub, OCI, Neo4j, Tencent), MCP/memory primitives, agent eval/tracing, and VS Code agent extensions. Key themes: local/CLI coding agents, Model Context Protocol adoption, agent eval/traces, and workspace memory/safety tooling. Many entries are single-package signals that need social or repo corroboration.
